verdict.rationale: Gitea's own docs say Gitea Actions is compatible with GitHub Actions. Users write workflows in the same YAML format and can reuse thousands of existing GitHub Actions, which can be downloaded from any Git website. That covers reusing both workflow definitions and community actions from another CI platform. The evidence is high-level marketing and docs copy, so how far compatibility goes is not shown. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of compatibility scope and limits (which workflow syntax or features are unsupported), and independent or hands-on confirmation that GitHub workflows run unmodified.
